_comment: Hero mode: what each of Alexander's attacks does and what it costs him. The damage values are the original's - it models every attack as its own dbobjects record: 'Alexander Melee - 3rd Person' (150, twice what he does under RTS control), 'Alexander Archer - 3rd Person' (700) and 'Alexander Archer - Marksman' (1000). Stamina itself is nowhere in the data files, so the numbers below are tuned by hand: they follow the rule that the heavier the blow, the more it takes out of him. Same for the heavy melee blow, which has an animation in the original (alex_3p_msatck) but no record of its own.
